name: 作業データベースの条件帯
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Component LH09-0045: Japanese task database filter strip only.
ORIGINAL images1 and2 take PRIMARY authority for icon shapes, proportions, stroke/optical weights, baseline, spacing and detail. Image3 is secondary Japanese content/layout guide; do not reproduce its circle/club/square approximations.
Make one compact left-aligned horizontal row of FIVE white thin-neutral-outline pills, each has authentic leading icon then exact Japanese label then small downward chevron: segmented radial status icon「状態」; original two-person silhouette「担当者」; original outline calendar「期日」; up-right relation arrow「期間」; up-right relation arrow「案件」. After five pills, show a thin plus then plain text「条件を追加」with no enclosing pill. Use original thin rounded pills and optical icon sizes, no invented selected state or count. Coherent slate #526173 utility icons and quiet gray labels, Meiryo Regular14/24 and tracking0. Pure-white canvas, calm compact hierarchy, no bold type, tinted fills, heavy shadows, new buttons, new elements or additional panels. No accent: all shown filters inactive; no green selected pill. Sharp faithful UI candidate.
reviewNotes: Five inactive pills, five authentic icon types, chevrons and plain add-condition action inspected; Japanese copy complete, white surfaces and neutral slate coherent. Calendar internal detail differs from original; exact font/vector/output scale and behavior unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
